articles.title: From Ancient China to NASA: The Surprising Science of Paper Airplanes
articles.summary: National Paper Airplane Day is May 26. The world record throw is 252.6 feet—farther than a Boeing 737 wingspan. NASA offers free folding guides for its experimental aircraft, blending art and aeronautics.

articles.title: Mirror Image in Space: Artemis 2 Boosters Separate with Stunning Precision
articles.summary: A breathtaking photo from NASA's Artemis 2 mission shows the SLS rocket's twin boosters separating in perfect symmetry. The boosters provided 75% of the thrust needed to escape Earth's gravity before being jettisoned.

articles.title: A Fish Out of Water? Ancient Predator's Brain Hints at How We Got Legs
articles.summary: Using neutron imaging, scientists examined the skull of Koharalepis jarviki, a 380-million-year-old fish from Antarctica. Its brain shares features with species that bridged the water-to-land transition.
